_comment: Machine-readable version of docs/api-compatibility-matrix.md. The switch scripts derive their guards from THIS file: routing a route to a target flagged 'write-cutover' needs -AcceptWriteDivergence, one flagged 'incompatible' needs -AcceptIncompatibility. 'monolith' is the source of truth and is always allowed.

user-service.notes: Compatible on the success path: same paths, same UserRead body {id,name,created_at}, same 200/404/422 codes, verified byte-identical for the same row. Error BODY shape differs (monolith {detail}, user-service {error:{code,message,request_id}}); data is the CDC replica (eventually consistent, typically < 1 s).

Writes land ONLY in the user-service DB; there is no user-service -> monolith sync, so the monolith (still source of truth, and the owner of sales.user_id FK) diverges. Also: user-service accepts a blank name ('   ') that the monolith rejects with 422; PUT/DELETE exist only on user-service.

sales-service.notes: BREAKING for the frontend: SaleRead has no user_name (monolith JOINs users; the frontend renders sale.user_name). GET /sales is paginated (limit default 100, max 1000) while the monolith returns every row. 404/422 bodies differ.
Writes land ONLY in the sales-service DB (no sync back). POST /sales does not check that user_id exists (monolith: 404) and the 201 body has no user_name.
